summary: Sets or clears bit a2 (bit index) in the byte array whose base pointer is stored at this[0]. a3 selects the action: nonzero sets the bit, zero clears it. Returns the resulting mask byte.

local_names.this: int* object whose first dword holds the byte-array base
local_names.a2: bit index to set or clear

operations.description: mask = 1 << (a2 & 7): single-bit mask for the bit position of a2 within its byte
byte_index = a2 >> 3: byte offset within the array that contains bit a2
base = this[0]: load the byte-array base pointer stored as the first dword of this
branch on a3: nonzero takes the set branch, zero takes the clear branch
set branch: byte at (base + byte_index) is ORed with mask, turning bit a2 on
clear branch: byte at (base + byte_index) is ANDed with the bitwise negation of mask, turning bit a2 off
return mask: the positive mask in the set branch, the complemented mask in the clear branch
